resolved_findings.source_style_chain: Strong_20_Emphasis > T286: font-weight normal; text-underline-style solid, underline width auto, color font-color over each entire phrase.

resolved_findings.correction: Use one underline group for each complete phrase, keeping originalleadbreak outside, and refresh ledger.
